name: hard-cross-file-rename
prompt: Rename the function compute_total to calculate_total everywhere in this project. Every call site must be updated and nothing may still refer to the old name.

check.cmd: {python} -c "import glob,main; src=''.join(open(f).read() for f in glob.glob('*.py')); assert 'compute_total' not in src, 'old name still present'; assert src.count('calculate_total')>=3, 'not renamed everywhere'; assert main.run([1,2,3])==(6,'total=6'); print('OK')"

name: hard-follow-project-pattern
prompt: In net.py the timeout is hardcoded. Make it configurable in exactly the same way the rest of this project already makes things configurable. Do not invent a new mechanism, and keep 30 as the default.

files.settings.py:
import os

RETRIES = int(os.environ.get('APP_RETRIES', '3'))
WORKERS = int(os.environ.get('APP_WORKERS', '4'))

check.cmd: {python} -c "import os,glob,subprocess,sys; src=''.join(open(f).read() for f in glob.glob('*.py')); assert 'APP_TIMEOUT' in src, 'did not follow the APP_ naming pattern'; e=dict(os.environ,APP_TIMEOUT='99'); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c','import net;print(net.timeout())'],capture_output=True,text=True,env=e); assert r.stdout.strip()=='99', r.stdout+r.stderr; d=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c','import net;print(net.timeout())'],capture_output=True,text=True); assert d.stdout.strip()=='30', d.stdout+d.stderr; print('OK')"

name: hard-three-step-pipeline
prompt: Build a tiny word-frequency tool as three files. tokens.py: tokenize(text) returning a list of lowercase words with punctuation stripped. counts.py: top(text, n) importing tokenize from tokens and returning the n most common (word, count) pairs, most frequent first, ties broken alphabetically. cli.py: when run as a script with a filename argument, prints the single most common word in that file and nothing else.

files.sample.txt: the cat sat on the mat. The CAT! the dog?

check.cmd: {python} -c "import subprocess,sys; from tokens import tokenize; from counts import top; assert tokenize('The CAT! dog?')==['the','cat','dog'], tokenize('The CAT! dog?'); assert top('a b b c c',2)==[('b',2),('c',2)], top('a b b c c',2); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'cli.py','sample.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True); assert r.stdout.strip()=='the', r.stdout+r.stderr; print('OK')"
